title: Endpoint Telemetry: process_start v1
description: Raw telemetry event emitted when a new process is created on an endpoint. Sent to /v1/ingest with telemetry_type=endpoint.

process_name.description: Process image name (e.g. 'cmd.exe', 'python3'). No path — basename only.

process_path.description: Full filesystem path to the process executable.

pid.description: OS process identifier assigned at launch.

command_line.description: Full command line string including all arguments as seen by the OS.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the process binary (hex, 64 chars).

integrity_level.description: Windows integrity level of the spawned process. Omit on non-Windows.

session_id.description: Windows session ID. Omit on non-Windows.
